description: GitIngest turns Git repositories into structured plain-text digests that summarize repository structure and file contents for use with large language models. Its website also offers a web interface for ingesting public or private GitHub repositories.
summary: gitingest.com exposes one public HTTP API documented by an OpenAPI schema at `https://gitingest.com/openapi.json`; no GraphQL API, MCP server, or gitingest.com-hosted CLI surface was found.
